crop.notes: Whole 'The Courts' column of unrelated court notes; only the paragraph on the dismissal in the Mollie McCoole case mentions Allen.

title.suggested: Case Against Mike McCoole's Ex-Wife Dismissed

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat reported that the Court of Criminal Correction dismissed the case of Mollie McCoole after being told that she, the ex-wife of Tom Allen's opponent, had left the city.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The St. Louis Democrat: St. Louis, Thursday, October 30, 1873' (same page as 495). Pre-1875 merger.

notes: Current title wrongly makes her the ex-wife of 'McCoole's opponent'; the text says she is the ex-wife of Allen's opponent (Mike McCoole). No facts about Allen himself.
